about_the_game:
Legend of the Flame Dragon Knight - Star Sea Battle, Hundred Formation Duel!

1、 Game background

In the vast Starry Universe, stars collide with the power of shadows, giving birth to four heroic professions: warrior, mage, priestess, and archer. Players take on the role of 'Star Luo Commander', leading heroes and cute pet armies to battle against evil forces on the epic battlefield of 100vs100, rewriting the fate of the universe.

2、 Core gameplay highlights

（1） Four Heroes, Professional Expertise

***Warrior: melee tank, wielding a sword to charge forward, possessing skills of "sharp knife" and "shield", firmly guarding the front row.

***Magician: Remote output, manipulate elements, and use skills such as "Stone Crush" and "Toxic Liquid" to turn the tide of the battle.

***Holy Maiden: Healing aid, wielding the Holy Light scepter to heal teammates, dispel negativity, and revive units.

***Bow Swordsman: Flexible output, using bows and arrows and short swords for long-range sniping and melee assault, with the ability to switch between "Cloud Piercing Arrow" and "Shadowless Dart" skills.

（2） Equipment forging, exclusive divine weapon

***Dynamic Drop: Challenge dungeons, explore ruins, obtain rare materials and blueprints, and create epic equipment such as the "Burning Demon Blood Blade" and "Soul Shooting Staff".

***Set effect: Collecting specific sets activates powerful attribute bonuses, such as the "Warrior Holy War Set" to increase attack and critical hit rates.

（3） Hero Cute Pet Gathering, Strategic Matching

***Pet Guide: From the cute "succubus" to the domineering "Hydra", pets have exclusive skills and evolutionary forms.

***Skill example: "Hot Fireball" releases "Electromagnetic Storm" range damage and adds paralysis; The 'pastor' recovers a large amount of blood and provides an 'immune lethal damage' shield.

***Binding System: Specific pet combinations trigger special effects such as "Elemental Resonance", such as "Water Fire Elf" releasing a "Ground Splitting Explosion" that causes sustained burning.

（4） Hundred troops, strategic showdown

***100vs100 Battlefield: Deploy and deploy 100 heroes and pets to the battlefield, arrange the front, back, and flank layouts to determine the winner.

***Real time combat: Hero and pet skills are released, and critical moments can turn the tide of the battle, such as saving teammates when a saint is on the brink of death.

3、 Diversified cultivation

（1） Dragon Soul System

Light up the hero and pet star chart branches, customize exclusive growth directions, such as "Critical Strike Stream Warriors" and "Group Attack Mages".

（2） Pet Devouring Evolution

Consume low-level pet fusion, enhance attributes, unlock new skills or appearances.

（3） Equipment Gem Embedding - Refining

Inject energy into equipment gems to embed additional items, such as "Kill to restore health" and "Probability stun", and refine and enhance basic attributes.

4、 Game Features

Title system: Each title is extremely precious, without boring brushing tasks

Equipment System: Enhancement, Synthesis, Transfer, Blessing, Transformation, Attributes, Excellence, Production, Embedding, Refining, Fusion

Level System: Upgrade, Sweep, Eliminate, Monster Flash Kill

Time system: Business trips and appointments won't be delayed, offline idle time storage, uninterrupted battles with peace of mind and no losses

Arena: Challenge based on different combat power zones

Ranking: Ranking by different occupational categories

Weapon Catalog: Collecting top-notch equipment all the way, born for collecting

Compete with global players for rankings, win limited titles and rare pets.

The Legend of the Flame Dragon Knight combines strategy, cultivation, role-playing, pet collection, and sandbox battles to create an adventure across the stars for players. Whether you are a strategy master, a collector, or a liver king, you can find your own star stage here.

Now, step into the stars and write your own legend!

Developer's message:

We are committed to creating a game that makes every battle unique. May you find your own star and glory in 'Legend of the Flame Dragon Knight'

——Yanlong Knight Legend Development Team

Official QQ group: 818741654
